## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix duplicate adoption output: the command now emits each adoption message twice. This review traced planner records through command rendering and read all existing and added tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and audit metadata to settings plans, with tests for audit suppression and empty-input audit results.

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message only once — With `current={"theme": "dark"}` and `incoming={"theme": "dark"}`, `run()` emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits progress at line 8, then the new adoption record causes `app/cli.py:9` to emit the same message again. The existing adoption test calls only `plan()`, so it does not detect the command-level duplication. — Users receive duplicate progress messages whenever the command adopts an existing setting. — Fix: Preserve the planner’s progress emission and prevent the command renderer from emitting adoption records again.
